def VTask.prev {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  have h₁ : l ≠ [] := by
    by_contra h₁
    rw [h₁] at h
    simp at h
  
  have h₂ : α := by
    have h₃ : ∃ (last : α), last = List.getLast l h₁ := by
      refine' ⟨List.getLast l h₁, _⟩
      <;> rfl
    -- Define the auxiliary function prevAux
    have h₄ : ∀ (l : List α) (prev : α) (x : α), x ∈ l → α := by
      intro l prev x hx
      match l with
      | [] =>
        exfalso
        simp_all
      | [y] =>
        -- If the list is [y], then x must be y, and we return y
        have h₅ : x = y := by
          simp_all [List.mem_cons]
          <;> aesop
        simp_all
      | y :: ys =>
        -- If the list is y :: ys, we check if y = x
        by_cases h₅ : y = x
        · -- If y = x, we return prev
          simp_all
        · -- If y ≠ x, we recurse on ys with prev := y
          have h₆ : x ∈ ys := by
            simp_all [List.mem_cons]
            <;> aesop
          have h₇ : α := @h₄ ys y x h₆
          exact h₇
    -- Use the auxiliary function to find the predecessor
    have h₅ : α := @h₄ l (List.getLast l h₁) x h
    exact h₅
  
  exact h₂
